stemBlocks: A bar magnet is placed at position X close to one end of a coil and on the axis of the coil as shown. The graph shows how the velocity of the magnet varies as it is then moved rapidly to position Y and back to position X. The magnetic field of the bar magnet still affects the coil when the magnet is at position Y.
Which graph represents how the induced voltage in the coil changes as the magnet moves?
